summary.text: Hadley Luddy is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Barnstable District since January 2025 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Luddy took office on January 1, 2025, after winning the district in the 2024 general election, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs and the joint committees on Agriculture and Fisheries, Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets, and Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development.
